name: Klaus Nikolayev
source:
Klaus Nikolayev is the self-designated class clown, and he's quite popular around campus. Even without having a nickname like "Santa," Klaus is generous and kind, willing to go the extra mile for his buddies. He's friendly, energetic, and easy to get along with, but don't talk shit or you'll get hit. Seriously. He lifts so you don't wanna mess with the stuff he cares about.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=20120]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
